recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up portrait of a young person with a large afro, set against a soft-focus natural background. The lighting is warm and directional, casting shadows that define facial features, paired with bold, outlined sans-serif and decorative script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark silhouette of the hair against the dappled light background
The contrast between the busy floral pattern of the shirt and the smooth skin tones
The balance between the top-left decorative text and the bottom-right bold title
Warm, earthy tones throughout the image creating a nostalgic atmosphere
coreInvariants: Warm color temperature with high contrast shadows
Large-scale afro hairstyle as a central graphic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame, with the head positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, which are looking slightly off-camera to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves up to the volume of the hair, then travels diagonally between the text elements in the top-left and bottom-right corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image is dominated by the blurred foliage, providing space for the hair and top-left text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and warm ochres in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red used for the primary text elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted saturation in the background with high-value highlights on the shirt and face; text is highly saturated to stand out.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or neon colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and high-contrast decorative script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy weight with a thin white outline
Decorative text features heart-shaped flourishes on initial caps
Tight letter spacing for the display title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters in the top-left text have integrated heart shapes in the terminals

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the upper negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid geometric sans-serif with a fluid, ornate script.
graphicDevices: Thin white outlines on bold text

preserve: The white outline on the bottom text
The heart flourishes on the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and structure of the display title
Provides the 70s decorative feel for the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s-style film photograph of a young person with a large afro wearing a vintage floral button-down shirt. The background should be a blurred forest with warm, dappled sunlight. Use a low-angle, medium-close-up shot with warm color grading.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, orange-red sans-serif title in the bottom right with a thin white outline. Add decorative script text in the top left in the same orange-red, featuring heart-shaped flourishes on the capital letters.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and directional?
Does the hair create a strong silhouette against the background?
Is the floral pattern on the shirt visible and detailed?
Are the text elements placed in the top-left and bottom-right corners?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the floral pattern on the shirt
mustRedesign: Exact facial likeness of the original artist

mustAchieve: Clear separation between subject and background
avoid: Overly sharp, modern digital photography look

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the afro has a soft, natural texture
Check that the white outline on the text is consistent
Verify the warm, earthy color palette is maintained
Confirm the low-angle perspective is correct
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned 70s portrait featuring a prominent afro and floral textures with a diagonal typographic layout using orange-red display fonts and white outlines.
